name: application-optimistic-pending-row
title: Optimistic Pending Row
description: Optimistic-update list row: an item added immediately on submit, rendered dimmed with a spinner and "Sending…" while in flight, settling to normal on success or to an error state with Retry/Dismiss on failure.
useWhen: Rendering a list (comments, messages, activity) where new items appear instantly via optimistic UI before the server confirms them.
You need a visible in-flight state and a recoverable failure state within the same row, not just a loading spinner for the whole list.
Distinct from Inline Add Row, which is the always-present composer row used to create a new item, not the transient in-flight state of an item already submitted.
avoidWhen: You need the input row itself where the user types a new item — use Inline Add Row instead.
Requests are synchronous or fast enough that a pending state is never visible — a plain row is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Row content stays on one line with avatar, text, and (when failed) actions via flex; long titles truncate through min-w-0 rather than pushing actions off-screen.
accessibility: Pending and failed rows carry aria-live="polite" so status transitions are announced to screen reader users without needing focus.
The pending spinner is aria-hidden since the adjacent "Sending…" text conveys the same state as visible text.
The failed row swaps the avatar for a warning icon plus red status text, conveying failure through both icon and text, not color alone.

variants.title: Optimistic Pending Row
variants.description: Three rows: a settled sent comment, a dimmed pending comment with a spinner, and a failed comment with Retry/Dismiss actions.
accessibility: Pending and failed rows carry aria-live="polite" for status-change announcements.

variants.title: Optimistic Pending Row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three row states adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status icon and text contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
